notes: First page of Table XV Part I (Mother-tongue), cols 1-19: Population; Total A-(i) Languages of the Presidency; Hindustani; Kanarese; Korava or Yerukala; Lambadi. Table continues on leaves 287-289 (printed pp. 281-283). Row serial numbers (1.-29.) dropped from area names; row 12 'Madras' is the city district. Nil cells ('..') omitted; where only females are nil (Kanarese Ganjam Agency, Korava Coimbatore, Lambadi Godavari East Plains) females is null. All P=M+F and all area totals (Madras = British Territory + States; British Territory = 26 districts; district = Agency + Plains; States = 3 states) reconcile for every column on this leaf.
